title: Starting sounds
goal: Twenty-two consonant sounds start a syllable: seven single keys, the rest neighbouring keys pressed together.

blocks.x: Strike the letter of the sound.
The rest are neighbouring keys together. `P`+`W` is *b*, `T`+`K` is *d*, `P`+`H` is *m*.

blocks.x: Strike any of these; the board label shows the result.
Three starts follow spelling, not sound, so words that sound alike can differ: `wh` is [[WH]] (*when*), `wr` is [[WR]] (*write*), and `sc` as in *scan* is [[SK]]. See lesson 9.
No sound is left off: a word's opening sound always has its key. Only a memorised brief may drop one.
